title: Agent-facing verification spec (verification_spec_v1)
description: The answer-free acceptance contract handed to a bring-up agent, DERIVED by merlin.targetgen.verification_spec from the graded capsules' own declarations (capsule.yaml only -- never golden.yaml). Written into the agent workspace as verification_spec.md plus this JSON sibling. Because it is derived from the graded corpus, whatever the corpus does not demand it does not require; `not_checked` is the explicit admission of the obligations nothing enforces, which is the half an agent could not otherwise see.

ops.description: One entry per operation the graded capsules declare. The key is the capsule's own `operation.op`.

checked_by.description: WHAT ACTUALLY LOOKS at a submission for this operation, derived from the capsules' declarations. A false/empty field is not a relaxation -- it means nothing enforces that obligation, and the matching `not_checked` entry says so in words.

not_checked.description: Obligations this spec states or implies that nothing enforces. NEVER EMPTY: the first entry is the standing admission that no checker compares a submission to this document at all.
